regular_Collins: R(v)=2*CF*v*log(v)/(1-v), unweighted convolution integral_x^1 dv/v R(v)*Hhat3(x/v)
weighted_native_regular: -2*CF*exp(-2*y)*y/(1-exp(-y)), y=-ln(v); limit -2*CF at y=0; virtual/delta pieces are zero
coupling: Use the same contracted physical alpha_s at each supplied Q2, not the auxiliary constant alpha=1 used to construct LO evolution. All coupling/scales remain fixed settings.
row_construction: Single query-bound negative-order grids only. With D=diag(x), the regular unweighted row is D*U_w(tau)^T*R_w^T*(e_i/x_i), projected onto h(1)=0. Apply the retained convolution transpose for R once and for each U; no dense x-by-x matrix or nodes-by-scales-by-scales tensor. At tau=0 use the R cotangent directly. Check rows against a full retained R*(U*h) map before closing the native context.
cache: HoppetMatchingPlan has explicit process/physical-alpha metadata and remains distinct from evolution-only HoppetPointPlan. Julia generic row products evaluate fitted initial conditions/derivatives; no foreign or Python callbacks in fitting iterations. Repeated queries share preparation and preserve order; x=1 returns zero.
independent_oracle: Mellin moments R_N=-2*CF*trigamma(N+1); multiply the analytic initial moment by exp(tau*P_N) and the process coefficient. Validate complex trigamma with direct moments, recurrence and inversion contour changes, and tau0 matching with independent fixed quadrature.

validation_policy.physical_refinement_policy: Retain all coarse levels. At or above the declared minimum, stop a process/quantity only when every supplied scale passes the same final adjacent-grid comparison. Refine only unconverged cases within the fixed budget; exhaustion is FAIL. The initial SIA Collins Q2=0.6, z=0.05, u pilot failed 512-to-1024 refinement (1.315e-4 versus 1e-4) and remains recorded.
validation_policy.physical_Q0_reference: Direct strict pinned-input matching, split at all source knots; refine quadrature before comparing. Nonzero-scale checks also require initial/evolution/matching grid refinements and an independently refined dense route.

identity_dimension_stress.scope: Q0 matching/row-storage interface only; no physical 2336-scale fitting-throughput claim

limits: Reconstructed matching legs only, not a TMD observable or data likelihood
No polarized gluon matching or complete twist-three mixing
Fixed settings only; fitting coupling/scales requires dU and dC
Original author code and historical benchmark are unavailable
Source-scale prescriptions, target/axis/bin/acceptance adapters, covariance/overlap and production derivative/performance/coverage admission remain open
